correctness.rationale: Reconstructed seven nonabsorbing-state Markov first-step linear equations. The reported rational formula (T_center-T_leaf)=N(c,t)/D(c,t) has positive denominator for c,t>0. Inspected symbolic checker rebuilds the 7-state generator and computes exact rational inverse, then verifies polynomial numerator and coefficient root isolation rather than relying only on a saved log. Each coefficient A_j(t) has one positive threshold, strictly ordered from theta0=1 to theta7=6; Descartes signs in c give a single positive crossover for 1<t<6, with opposite uniform signs outside. Two-state generator gives a difference with c-independent sign, proving minimality. Independent rational inversions at t=2 gave T_center-T_leaf=-38243/145208 for c=1 and +10721/179952 for c=3. Finite samples are only corroboration.
residual_risks: Finite algebraic/numerical checks are supplemental and do not independently certify the quantified proof.
